unavailable.title: Not available
unavailable.body: The supplier portal of this link is not open. Please check the link or ask the person who sent it to you.

login.title: Sign in to the supplier portal
login.intro: Type the e-mail this organization has on record. We will send a sign-in link, usable once, to that address.
login.sent: If this e-mail is on record, a sign-in link will arrive within a few minutes. Please check your inbox.
login.closed: Your account is closed. To use the portal again, please contact procurement.

link.title: Confirm your sign-in
link.intro: Press the button to get a six-digit code by e-mail. This link works once.

otp.title: Enter your code
otp.intro: We sent a six-digit code to your e-mail. It works for 10 minutes, on this device only.

home.todoEmpty: Nothing to do now. When a document is about to expire or new work comes, it shows here and we e-mail you.

todo.DOCUMENT_EXPIRING: {type} expires on {date}: send a new copy
todo.DOCUMENT_EXPIRED: {type} has expired: send a new copy

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.2026-11-01: This organization keeps the names, e-mails, phone numbers and documents you send through the portal to register suppliers, to contact you about purchases and payments, and for checks the law requires. They are kept for the period the organization sets and shown only to those whose work needs them. You may ask its procurement team for a copy, a correction or deletion of your data.
privacy.short: {organization} uses what you send through this portal to register suppliers, to contact you about purchases and payments, and for checks the law requires.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please try again in a moment.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link does not work. Please ask for a new sign-in link.
errors.TOKEN_USED: This link was used already. Please ask for a new sign-in link.
errors.TOKEN_EXPIRED: This link has expired. Please ask for a new sign-in link.
errors.OTP_INVALID: The code is not right. {remaining} tries left.
errors.OTP_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Try again after {time}.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Please ask for a new sign-in link.
errors.PRIVACY_NOTICE_OUTDATED: Please read and acknowledge the current privacy notice first.
errors.FAILED: That did not work. Please try again.

apply.title: Supplier application
apply.saveNext: Save and go to the next step
apply.returned: Procurement returned the application for changes: {reason}

company.intro: As on your company certificate or ID card

tax.foreign: A foreign supplier has no Thai taxpayer id to give

contact.intro: These contacts may use the portal and get e-mails from {organization}. To add or change one, please ask its procurement team.
contact.language: Language of e-mails and the portal

bank.intro: The account to be paid into. Finance will call you to confirm it before any payment.
bank.accountNoKept: Saved, ending {last4}. Type a new one only to change it.

documents.intro: Send PDF files or pictures, 20 MB at most each. Every file is checked for viruses before procurement opens it.

state.INFECTED: The file failed the security check: send another

review.intro: Check before you send. Once sent, it can be changed only if procurement returns it.
review.missingTitle: Still missing before you can send
review.warningsTitle: Looks like a supplier already registered
review.warningsIntro: Please say briefly why it is not the same supplier. Procurement will check it.

warning.SAME_TAXID_OTHER_BRANCH: This taxpayer id is registered for another branch
warning.DUPLICATE_NAME: The name looks like a supplier already registered

closed.SUBMITTED: Application {number} was sent and procurement is checking it. We will e-mail you the result.
closed.PENDING_APPROVAL: Application {number} is waiting for approval. We will e-mail you the result.
closed.EXPIRED: The application expired. Please ask procurement for a new link.

errors.APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE: It cannot be sent yet: see what is missing below.
errors.TAXID_CHECKSUM: The taxpayer id is not valid. Please check it.
errors.DUPLICATE_SUPPLIER: This taxpayer id and branch are registered or applied for already. Please call procurement.
errors.DUPLICATE_REASON_REQUIRED: Please give a reason for each likeness to a registered supplier.
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: The application was just changed elsewhere. Please check the latest and save again.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This application can no longer be changed.
errors.ACCOUNT: The account number is not valid for this bank.

profile.title: My account
profile.closeBody: Once closed, you cannot sign in with this e-mail again. To come back, procurement has to add you again.
profile.closeConfirm: I understand and want to close this account
profile.close: Close my account and sign out
profile.closeLast: You are the primary contact, so you cannot close the account yourself. Please ask procurement to name a new primary contact first.
profile.closeConfirmNeeded: Please tick to confirm before closing the account.

help.title: Help

how.signIn: Sign in with the e-mail {organization} has on record. A one-time link and a six-digit code are sent each time.
how.fill: Fill in the application step by step and save. You may come back later to go on.
how.documents: Send documents as PDF files or pictures. We e-mail you before a document expires.
how.code: No one from the organization will ever ask you for your code.

help.contactGeneral: Please contact the procurement team of {organization} the way you usually do.
